profile: Selected ASCII AC1021 model-space sparse MATERIAL graphs and open/closed lightweight polylines, with zero widths and finite arc bulges. Source physical fields and delivered geometry are checked before replay. Arc joins allow 64 binary64 epsilons scaled by coordinates; straight joins remain exact. Flattened nonzero bulges and unsupported metadata are refused.

checks.beforeFix: The new open curved polyline test failed ordinary export before implementation.
checks.focused: 450 assertions, 3 cases; includes open/closed arcs, edit/reopen/resave, typed and physical source mismatch, live geometry rejection, destination preservation and corrected retry.
checks.bundled: Affected filter and test translation units compile with the bundled codec; no bundled runtime test is claimed.
checks.independentPeer: ezdxf 1.4.5 read 12 locally generated outputs, verifying moved vertices, positive and negative bulges, terminal/closing bulges and four MATERIAL references; all audits had zero errors or fixes. Virtual arc centers and radii agree with independent analytic values.
checks.scratchOnly: The generated DXF drawings and peer outputs remain in scratch storage and are not committed.

limitations: Reconstruction of source geometry uses the LibreCAD geometry implementation and is a consistency check, not independent native producer evidence.
The independent output check covers these generated examples, not arbitrary polylines, native GUI behavior, other producers, versions or platforms.
Widths, unsupported fields, flattened tiny arcs, rotated elliptic polyline output and broader MATERIAL graphs remain guarded.
